profile.headline: Engineering Manager at Apkudo
profile.summary:
Hi, I am Charles Patel, contributing to open-source software (Tensorflow, Instagram, Scikit-learn, PyCQA, etc). My expertise includes predictive analytics, anomaly detection, NLP, etc.
GitHub: https://github.com/acharles7

positions.title: Machine Learning Researcher
positions.description:
• Improved and automated admission process at San Jose State University using Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL)
• Improved accuracy by 15% when predicting the right candidate for university from a prior admission estimation system
• Redesigned Convolution Neural Network (CNN) & Recurrent (RNN) in C++ to integrate with bit-slice indexing (BSI) algorithms
• Achieved 6% performance gain in the processing of large sparse vectors through forward propagation of CNN in terms of speed

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Large Scale Analytics - Led a computer science's core course with 60+ students (Most popular class of Data Science), conducted quizzes, gave a tutorial on "GPU computing on High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster”
• Machine Learning for Big Data - Taught machine learning to undergraduate students with 1-on-1 tutoring, Gave a lecture on KNN
• Data Structures and Algorithms - Created interactive audio-visual presentations describing data structures and python basics to General Engineering students in addition to grading assignments, staffing course office hours
• Advanced Algorithm Design - Assisted and mentored students in groups as well as on an individual basis

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Restructured a campaign’s application in MVVM (Model–View–ViewModel) architecture
• Wrote test automation scripts for application performance and scalability as apart of test-driven development
• Studied & recommend different architecture for mobile application, MVC, MVP, etc. & helped in applying SDLC methodologies

certifications.name: Advanced NLP with Python for Machine Learning
certifications.title: Advanced NLP with Python for Machine Learning

projects.title: Go-travel
projects.description:
• Led a team of 3 to developed and designed flight and hotel booking website using AngularJS, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS
• Implemented pagination, added different localization strategies, applied search engine optimization (SEO) techniques
• Provided cross-browser compatibility, performed UI testing using Selenium and durability testing to measure the performance

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis On IMDB
projects.description:
Developed a three machine learning semantic model, Naive Bayes, SVM, NN, and, CNN that derives sentiment scores from IMDB dataset
Analyzed all the model on time is taken to train, accuracy metric, precision, recall, and loss.
